notes: §1985:VI.6.6.2 prints three ADD formats (TO, GIVING with two or more addends and only the word TO optional, CORRESPONDING), each ending '[ ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1 ]', then the NOT phrase, then END-ADD, in the sequence §1985:IV.2.1 binds ('Clauses must be written in the sequence given in the general formats'). addStatement parses the superset; BindAdd narrows it at every edition (Format1Receivers, GivingSendingOperand: COBOL1689 for ADD C GIVING D, a literal TO operand without GIVING, two TO operands with GIVING), BindAddCorresponding binds Format 3, VisitRoundedPhrase refuses ROUNDED MODE IS at 85 (COBOL0803), and VisitConditionalPhrases asks OutOfPrintedOrder and refuses NOT ON SIZE ERROR before ON SIZE ERROR at 85 (COBOL0900); both gaps of the prior PARTIAL read are closed on this tree. Probed at --std 85: (b) ADD TO C, ADD 1 TO 2, ADD C GIVING D, ADD 1 2 TO 3 4 GIVING D, ADD CORR G1 TO G2 GIVING D, ROUNDED twice, ON SIZE ERROR twice and the reversed phrase pair are refused; (c) ROUNDED MODE IS TRUNCATION refused; (d) ALL "1" refused COBOL0844, ZERO accepted, a signed S99V9 ROUNDED gives +04.5, an edited GIVING receiver 4.25; (f) an 18-digit item plus 1 takes SIZE ERROR and keeps its value, ADD 1 A TO 3 GIVING D takes SIZE ERROR and leaves D 00; (a) an ODO-table element receiver TE(I) is added; ADD 1 TO C GIVING D (identifier-2 after TO) gives 21. The witness runs the three formats in the printed phrase order. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5158 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-09.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-09-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "identifier-2 [ ROUNDED ] … [ ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-2 ]"; 2023: "identifier-2 [ rounded-phrase ]; ROUNDED [ MODE IS {AWAY-FROM-ZERO … TRUNCATION} ]; size-error phrases in choice indicators, any order". 2023 accepts more programs: ROUNDED MODE IS options, and NOT ON SIZE ERROR may precede ON SIZE ERROR. 1985 had bare ROUNDED and a fixed phrase order.
